gloss: to forbid; to prohibit; to suppress

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {禁|きん}じていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to forbid; to prohibit; to ban
definitions.explanation: To officially or authoritatively prohibit an action or behavior.

definitions.gloss: to suppress; to hold back (a feeling)
definitions.explanation: To restrain oneself from expressing an emotion, especially in expressions meaning unable to hold back tears or unable to suppress a feeling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：17580_kitsuen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{禁|きん}ずる。
⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{禁|きん}じられて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{区域|くいき}→区域：00251_kuiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{釣|つ}り→釣り：03439_tsuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{禁|きん}じられて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Fishing is prohibited in this area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{禁|きん}じえなかった。
examples.english: I couldn't hold back my tears.

examples.japanese: ⟦{驚|おどろ}き→驚き：02562_odoroki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{禁|きん}じえない。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦{悲|かな}しみ→悲しみ：05404_kanashimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{禁|きん}じえなかった。
examples.english: Upon hearing the news, I couldn't suppress my sadness.

notes:
A ずる verb (literary ichidan form of ⟦{禁|きん}じる→禁じる：13737_kinjiru⟧). Both {禁|きん}ずる and ⟦{禁|きん}じる→禁じる：13737_kinjiru⟧ are used, with ⟦{禁|きん}じる→禁じる：13737_kinjiru⟧ being more common in modern Japanese. The ずる form appears in signs, formal writing, and set phrases.

KEY EXPRESSION:
{禁|きん}じえない (unable to suppress/hold back) is a very common literary expression used with emotions: ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{禁|きん}じえない (unable to hold back tears), ⟦{驚|おどろ}き→驚き：02562_odoroki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{禁|きん}じえない (unable to suppress one's astonishment).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：17580_kitsuen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{禁|きん}ずる — to prohibit smoking
- ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{禁|きん}じる→禁じる：13737_kinjiru⟧ — to prohibit by law
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{禁|きん}じえない — unable to hold back tears
- ⟦{驚|おどろ}き→驚き：02562_odoroki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{禁|きん}じえない — unable to suppress astonishment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{禁止|きんし}する→禁止する：22145_kinshisuru⟧ — to prohibit; the most common modern way to express prohibition, while {禁|きん}ずる is more literary
- ⟦{制限|せいげん}する→制限する：19636_seigensuru⟧ — to restrict; implies limiting rather than completely banning
